pidgin_term: cover person for any loss
explanation: To protect or pay person back if wahala, loss, or extra cost happen because of di matter wey una agree.
example: If your work cause another person loss, you go indemnify am — meaning you go pay for di loss.

pidgin_term: big wahala wey nobody fit control
explanation: Serious event wey nobody cause and nobody fit stop — like flood, war, pandemic, or sudden government order — wey fit delay or stop people from do wetin dem promise.
example: If flood lock di road and goods no fit reach, na force majeure; dem no go treat am as say person just refuse to do di work.

pidgin_term: right to hold property until dem pay
explanation: Legal right wey person get to keep another person property or goods until di money wey dem owe don pay finish.
example: Mechanic fit get lien for your car until you pay di repair bill.

pidgin_term: deadline to take person go court
explanation: Di law set time limit. If you wait pass that time before you sue, court fit say your case don die.
example: If di statute of limitations for your matter na 6 years, you no fit wait 8 years come carry am go court.

pidgin_term: to drop your right
explanation: When you voluntarily leave one right wey you get, like say you no go claim am again. Once you waive am well, e fit hard to bring am back.
example: If you sign waiver, you don agree say you no go later come claim that right for court.

pidgin_term: which court get power for di matter
explanation: Di power wey particular court or authority get to hear and decide one case. If court no get jurisdiction, e no fit give valid judgment.
example: Lagos High Court no get jurisdiction to hear small tenancy matter wey law give only Magistrate Court.

pidgin_term: wetin each person give to make contract valid
explanation: Di something of value — money, work, goods, or promise — wey each side give di other. For many contracts, if consideration no dey, di agreement fit no bind.
example: You go pay ₦500,000, landlord go give you house for one year. That exchange na consideration.

pidgin_term: to break di agreement
explanation: When person fail to do wetin e promise for contract, or e do something wey di contract forbid.
example: If tenant no pay rent for three months, na breach of di tenancy agreement.

pidgin_term: money wey court go order person to pay for loss
explanation: Compensation — normally money — wey court give di person wey suffer loss because another person break di law or contract.
example: Court fit award damages make landlord pay tenant for property wey landlord spoil.

pidgin_term: fixed amount wey una don already agree if wahala happen
explanation: Amount wey parties write for contract as di money to pay if one side break di agreement. E suppose be fair estimate of loss, not just punishment.
example: If contractor delay finish house, e go pay ₦50,000 every week as liquidated damages.

pidgin_term: private judge wey una choose instead of regular court
explanation: Way to settle dispute outside normal court: una pick one or more independent people (arbitrators) wey go hear both sides and give decision wey fit bind una.
example: Di contract say any fight go first go arbitration for Lagos, not High Court.

pidgin_term: peace talk with middle person
explanation: Neutral person go help both sides talk and try reach agreement. Mediator no dey force judgment; e dey help una settle.
example: Before una sue, make una try mediation so matter no burn money for court.

pidgin_term: which country or state law go control di contract
explanation: Di law wey una choose go interpret di agreement if wahala happen. For Nigeria, e fit be Laws of Lagos, Laws of the Federation, or another place.
example: This agreement go dey under governing law of Lagos State, Nigeria.

pidgin_term: if one part no valid, di rest still stand
explanation: If court throw away one clause as illegal or invalid, di remaining parts of di contract go still work.
example: Because of severability, even if di non-compete clause fail, di salary and notice clauses still bind una.

pidgin_term: only wetin dey this paper na di full agreement
explanation: Clause wey say this written contract na di complete deal. Old talk, WhatsApp, or side promise wey no enter this paper no go count.
example: Entire agreement clause mean say landlord no fit later claim extra promise wey e tok for phone if e no write am here.

pidgin_term: to transfer your right give another person
explanation: To pass your rights (and sometimes duties) under a contract to somebody else. Some contracts no gree make you assign without permission.
example: Tenant no fit assignment of this lease to another person unless landlord write say e agree.

pidgin_term: promise say something true or go work well
explanation: Promise for contract say one fact true, or one product/service go meet certain standard. If e fail, di other side fit claim damages.
example: Seller warranty say di generator na brand new and e go work for 12 months.

pidgin_term: statement wey person make to convince you enter deal
explanation: Statement of fact wey one side give so di other side go agree. If e be lie and you rely on am, you fit cancel di contract or claim damages.
example: Agent representation say di land get C of O. If e be lie, buyer fit take am up.

pidgin_term: serious promise wey bind you
explanation: Formal promise inside deed or contract to do something, or not do something. Breaking covenant na breach.
example: Tenant covenant say e no go use di house as shop.

pidgin_term: thing wey must first happen before di deal start
explanation: Event or action wey must occur before a duty or contract become active. Until e happen, person no dey bound to perform that part.
example: Payment na condition precedent: landlord no go give key until you pay di first rent.

pidgin_term: to end di agreement
explanation: To stop a contract before or when e suppose expire, according to di rules wey di contract or law provide.
example: Either side fit termination of this job contract with one month notice.

pidgin_term: to cancel di contract make e be like e never happen
explanation: To unwind a contract and return both sides as close as possible to how dem dey before dem sign, often because of fraud, mistake, or misrepresentation.
example: If dem hide serious defect for di land, buyer fit seek rescission and collect e money back.

pidgin_term: law no go gree you change mouth after person don trust your word
explanation: If you make person believe something and dem act on am, you no fit later deny am just to punish dem.
example: Landlord tok say 'no worry pay next month'. If tenant rely, estoppel fit stop landlord from suddenly claiming that month as default.

pidgin_term: with genuine mind, no hide play
explanation: Acting honestly, without intent to cheat. A bona fide buyer na person wey buy property genuinely, no sabi say wahala dey for di title.
example: Court go protect bona fide buyer wey pay fair price and no know say di land get dispute.

pidgin_term: buyer make e open eye well
explanation: Old rule say buyer get duty to check wetin e dey buy. For land and some goods, you no fit later cry say you no inspect, unless seller hide something or lie.
example: Caveat emptor mean say before you buy that plot, check C of O, survey, and whether people dey stay there.

pidgin_term: this talk no go use against you for court
explanation: When settlement talk mark 'without prejudice', you fit negotiate freely. Di other side no suppose use that offer as admission of guilt later for trial.
example: Lawyer write without prejudice offer of ₦2 million to settle, so e no go count as say dem don admit liability.

pidgin_term: to do things with honest mind
explanation: Duty to act honestly, fairly, and no hide important thing. Insurance and some partnership deals take this one serious.
example: You must disclose your health history for insurance in good faith; if you hide am, dem fit reject claim.

pidgin_term: who go answer if wahala happen
explanation: Legal responsibility to pay, fix, or face consequence if loss, injury, or breach happen.
example: Di company go carry liability if their driver cause accident while e dey do official work.

pidgin_term: ceiling for how much you fit pay if wahala happen
explanation: Clause wey cap di maximum amount one side go pay if something go wrong. Some losses (like fraud or death from negligence) law no gree make you fully exclude.
example: Limitation of liability say company no go pay more than di fees wey you pay dem for 12 months.

pidgin_term: no leak di secret information
explanation: Duty not to share private information with people wey no suppose sabi. Breaking am fit bring injunction and damages.
example: Staff no fit post customer data online because of confidentiality clause.

pidgin_term: you no fit go do same business nearby for some time
explanation: Clause wey try stop worker or seller from starting competing business, often for a time and area. For Nigeria, e must be reasonable or court fit throw am away.
example: Di non-compete say you no go open similar shop within 2km for 12 months after you leave.

pidgin_term: ownership of idea, name, design, or content
explanation: Legal rights over creations of the mind — writing, logo, software, invention, brand name. Person wey own am fit stop others from using am without permission.
example: All intellectual property for di app logo and code remain for di company, not di freelance developer, unless una write otherwise.

pidgin_term: paper wey give another person power to act for you
explanation: Legal document wey authorise somebody (your attorney) to sign, collect money, or handle property on your behalf. E fit be general or limited.
example: If you dey abroad, you fit give your brother power of attorney to collect C of O and sign land papers.

pidgin_term: government paper wey show say you get right over land
explanation: In Nigeria, C of O na document wey state government issue to show you get statutory right of occupancy over land. E no always mean say title 100% clean — still do search.
example: No pay full land money until you see genuine Certificate of Occupancy and do land registry search.

pidgin_term: state permission to transfer land
explanation: Under the Land Use Act, you often need the Governor's consent before you validly assign, mortgage, or transfer right of occupancy. Without am, di transfer fit be incomplete.
example: Bank no go take di land as full security until governor's consent for di mortgage don come out.

pidgin_term: government tax for certain documents
explanation: Tax wey you pay on some instruments (agreements, deeds, receipts). If paper no stamp, court fit refuse to use am as evidence until you pay plus penalty.
example: Tenancy agreement wey pass a certain rent need stamp duty before you fit tender am well for court.

pidgin_term: map wey show di exact land boundary
explanation: Drawing by licensed surveyor wey mark size, location, and beacons of a plot. E help confirm say di land wey you dey buy na di same one for paper.
example: Carry surveyor go di site confirm di survey plan beacons before you pay.

pidgin_term: formal signed paper wey transfer or confirm right
explanation: A serious legal document, usually signed, sealed/attested, used to transfer land or create obligations. Deed of Assignment na common way to pass land interest in Nigeria.
example: Seller go sign deed of assignment to transfer e interest for di plot give you.

pidgin_term: right to stay for di house without unnecessary wahala
explanation: Tenant right to use the property peacefully without landlord disturbing, harassing, or allowing others to interfere unlawfully.
example: Landlord no fit dey enter your room anytime e like; e go break quiet enjoyment.

aliases: notice of owner's intention to recover possession
pidgin_term: official notice say make you comot from di house
explanation: Written notice wey landlord give tenant to leave the premises. For Nigeria, di length and form depend on tenancy type and state tenancy law. Wrong notice fit spoil eviction case.
example: For yearly tenancy, quit notice often need plenty months; no pack out just because one WhatsApp message land.

pidgin_term: to comot tenant from di house
explanation: Process of removing a tenant. For Nigeria, landlord normally need valid notices plus court order. Self-help like throwing property outside or locking tenant out fit be illegal.
example: Landlord no get right to lock your door and throw your things; proper eviction pass through court.

pidgin_term: money for di period you stay after your right don expire
explanation: Amount court fit order occupier to pay for using property after tenancy don end, often calculated like rent for that extra period.
example: If you refuse to leave after quit notice and judgment, you fit pay mesne profits until you comot.

pidgin_term: agreement to use property for fixed time for rent
explanation: Contract wey give exclusive possession of property for a stated term in exchange for rent. Different from mere permission (licence).
example: A 2-year lease give tenant exclusive possession of di shop until di term end, as long as e pay rent.

pidgin_term: arrangement wey person dey rent and stay for another person property
explanation: Legal relationship between landlord and tenant. E fit be weekly, monthly, yearly, or for a fixed term. Rights and notices depend on how una set am.
example: Monthly tenancy mean say notice period and rent cycle dey run month by month.

pidgin_term: use property as security for loan
explanation: You borrow money and put land or house as security. If you no pay, lender fit take steps (with legal process) to recover from di property.
example: Bank take mortgage over di house; if you default, dem fit start process to sell am recover di loan.

pidgin_term: property wey you put down for loan
explanation: Asset pledged so lender go gree give you money. If you no pay, dem fit go after that asset.
example: Your car papers na collateral for di salary loan.

pidgin_term: lender take di property because you no pay
explanation: Legal process wey mortgagee use to take and sell or keep the security when borrower default. Procedure must follow law and the mortgage deed.
example: After plenty default, bank start foreclosure on di house to recover di outstanding loan.

pidgin_term: right to pass or use another person land for particular purpose
explanation: Limited right over another person's land, like right of way to your own house, drainage, or light. You no own di land; you just get that use.
example: Neighbour get easement to walk through di side of your compound to reach e own gate.

pidgin_term: written statement wey you swear na true
explanation: Written evidence wey person swear before commissioner for oaths or notary. Lying for affidavit na serious offence (perjury).
example: You go swear affidavit say you lost your original certificate before dem go give you certified true copy.

pidgin_term: di person wey carry di case go court
explanation: The party that starts a civil case, asking court for relief. In some Nigerian courts dem dey call am Claimant.
example: Di plaintiff sue di company for unpaid salary.

pidgin_term: di person wey dem don sue
explanation: The person or company answering a claim in court. Dem get right to defend and file their own case if the rules allow.
example: Di defendant deny say e owe di money wey dem claim.

pidgin_term: court paper wey start di case and call you come
explanation: Official process that begins many High Court actions and commands the defendant to appear and answer the claim.
example: Once writ of summons serve you, no ignore am; time dey run to enter appearance.

pidgin_term: paper wey explain wetin you dey claim and why
explanation: Pleading where the claimant sets out facts, legal basis, and the exact relief e want from court.
example: Statement of claim go list di contract date, how dem break am, and di ₦3 million you dey ask.

pidgin_term: paper wey di other side use reply your claim
explanation: Defendant's pleading that admits, denies, or explains the claimant's story and may raise other defences.
example: For statement of defence, tenant fit say e don already pay and attach receipts.

pidgin_term: final decision wey court give
explanation: The court's official decision that determines the rights of the parties. After judgment, enforcement fit follow if person no obey.
example: Di judgment order landlord to refund ₦800,000 and give tenant 14 days to leave.

pidgin_term: to carry di case go higher court make dem review am
explanation: Ask a higher court to look at whether the lower court make legal or factual error. Appeal get strict time limits.
example: If you no gree with Magistrate judgment, you fit file appeal to High Court within di time wey law give.

pidgin_term: court order wey stop person from doing something
explanation: Court command to do, or not do, a specific thing, often urgently to prevent irreparable harm. Breaking injunction na contempt.
example: Court give injunction wey stop neighbour from building on di disputed boundary until di case finish.

pidgin_term: court hear only one side, urgently
explanation: Application heard without the other party present, usually because of emergency. Court still expect you to be honest (full disclosure).
example: Lawyer go ex parte to freeze account because e fear say dem go siphon di money overnight.

pidgin_term: whether you even get right to bring this case
explanation: You must show sufficient interest or that your right dey affected. If you no get locus standi, court fit strike out the case.
example: Random neighbour no get locus standi to sue over a contract wey e no sign, unless law give am that right.

pidgin_term: on the face of am, e look like say case don show
explanation: Evidence that is enough at first look to support a claim, unless the other side rebut it.
example: Receipts and bank alerts fit establish prima facie proof say you pay rent.

pidgin_term: who suppose prove wetin e tok
explanation: The duty to prove a fact. In civil cases e dey usually on the person who asserts. Standard na balance of probabilities, not 'beyond reasonable doubt' (that one na mainly criminal).
example: If you claim say you pay, burden of proof dey your side to show receipt or transfer.

pidgin_term: more likely true than not
explanation: Civil standard of proof: court go believe the side wey story more likely, even if e no 100% sure.
example: For contract case, you no need prove like criminal matter; balance of probabilities dey enough.

pidgin_term: no reasonable doubt remain say e do am
explanation: High standard for criminal conviction. If reasonable doubt remain, accused suppose get benefit of that doubt.
example: Police must prove theft beyond reasonable doubt before court go convict.

pidgin_term: court order wey force person to come or bring paper
explanation: Command to attend court as witness or produce documents. Ignoring subpoena fit bring contempt proceedings.
example: Bank receive subpoena to bring di account statements for di fraud trial.

pidgin_term: to disrespect or disobey court
explanation: Conduct that insults the court or disobeys its order. Punishment fit be fine or imprisonment.
example: If you post the child's name online after court ban am, that one fit be contempt of court.

pidgin_term: person wey law authorise to swear your affidavit
explanation: Official before whom you swear that an affidavit or statutory declaration is true. Many court registries and some lawyers dey serve this function.
example: Carry your affidavit go commissioner for oaths stamp am before you file for court.

pidgin_term: make dem hear you fair before dem punish or decide
explanation: Right to be notified, to know the case against you, and to be heard. Nigerian Constitution protect fair hearing.
example: School no fit expel student without due process — query, chance to reply, and fair panel.

pidgin_term: basic rights wey Constitution give every person
explanation: Rights in Chapter IV of the 1999 Constitution (as amended): life, dignity, personal liberty, fair hearing, private life, thought, expression, and others. You fit enforce dem in High Court.
example: Unlawful detention by police fit be fundamental human rights case for High Court.

pidgin_term: court order make dem bring di person wey dem hold come court
explanation: Remedy used to challenge unlawful detention. Court fit order the detaining authority to produce the person and justify the detention.
example: Family file habeas corpus when police hold their brother pass the allowed time without charge.

pidgin_term: temporary freedom while case still dey on
explanation: Release of an accused person with conditions (and often sureties) pending trial. Bail no mean say person don free forever.
example: Court grant bail with two sureties and order say e no go travel out of state.

pidgin_term: court authority to manage dead person property
explanation: If person die with a will, executors seek probate. If no will (intestate), family seek letters of administration before dem fit deal with bank or land.
example: Bank no go release di deceased account until you show probate or letters of administration.

pidgin_term: person wey you name as close contact — e no automatically inherit everything
explanation: Next of kin na contact person. E no equal automatic owner of your property. Inheritance still follow will or customary/statutory succession rules.
example: Even if your name na next of kin for bank form, you still need probate or LoA to collect the money.

pidgin_term: traditional law wey community dey use
explanation: Unwritten (often) rules of a community, recognised by Nigerian courts if not repugnant to natural justice, equity and good conscience, and not incompatible with statute.
example: Some land under customary law dey family property; one person no fit sell am alone.

pidgin_term: marriage wey una do under Marriage Act
explanation: Marriage celebrated under the Marriage Act. E get different rights on property, divorce, and inheritance compared with some customary or Islamic marriages.
example: Statutory marriage no gree extra wife; another marriage on top fit be offence.

pidgin_term: who go take care of di pikin and where e go stay
explanation: Court decision on who has care and control of a child. Best interest of the child na di main guide, not just who 'win' the marriage fight.
example: Court give mama child custody and papa weekend access plus school fees.

pidgin_term: money to take care of spouse or pikin
explanation: Financial support ordered or agreed for a spouse and/or children after separation or divorce.
example: Papa go pay monthly maintenance for feeding, school, and hospital until di child adult.

pidgin_term: careless wey cause another person loss or injury
explanation: Failure to take the care a reasonable person would take, which causes foreseeable harm. Hospital, driver, employer, and professional people fit face this claim.
example: If hospital forget scissors for body after operation, that one fit be negligence.

pidgin_term: to spoil person name with false talk
explanation: Publishing a false statement that injures someone's reputation. Libel na written/posted; slander na spoken. Truth and fair comment fit be defence.
example: To post false accusation say somebody be thief for Facebook fit be defamation (libel).

pidgin_term: to enter person land or property without permission
explanation: Unlawful interference with another person's possession of land or goods. You no need to damage anything; mere unlawful entry fit be enough.
example: To jump di fence enter compound without consent na trespass.

pidgin_term: to disturb person from enjoy e property or public space
explanation: Unreasonable interference — noise, smell, blockage, pollution — with use of land or public rights.
example: Generator wey dey blow black smoke into neighbour window every night fit be private nuisance.

pidgin_term: person wey must put another person interest first
explanation: Position of trust (director, trustee, lawyer, agent) wey law expect loyalty and no secret profit.
example: Company director get fiduciary duty; e no fit divert company contract enter e own pocket.

pidgin_term: right to sell di security if you default
explanation: Right, often in a mortgage, for the lender to sell the property if the borrower does not pay, after required notices.
example: If you default, bank fit use power of sale — but dem still must follow notice and good-faith sale rules.

pidgin_term: part of contract wey say who go carry another person loss
explanation: Contract wording that shifts loss from one party to the other. Read am slow: e fit make you pay even for things you no cause, depending on how dem draft am.
example: Di indemnity clause say contractor go pay if anybody injure for site, even visitors.

pidgin_term: deadline na serious condition, no extra delay
explanation: If this phrase dey, late performance fit be treated as a serious breach, not just small delay.
example: Because time is of the essence, if you no deliver rice on 1 October, buyer fit reject di goods.

pidgin_term: e still dey valid and e dey work
explanation: Legal way to say a document or remaining clauses continue to bind the parties.
example: Even after amendment, di rest of di contract remain in full force and effect.

pidgin_term: lawyer English for 'for this paper / from now / of am'
explanation: Old-style connecting words. 'Hereinafter called the Tenant' just mean 'from now we go call this person Tenant for this paper'.
example: Mr Ade, hereinafter called the Tenant, go occupy Flat 4.

pidgin_term: even if another thing tok opposite
explanation: This word make the clause in front override other clauses. E dey powerful — always check wetin e dey push aside.
example: Notwithstanding any other clause, landlord fit enter if fire dey.

pidgin_term: but this condition still apply
explanation: Introduces an exception or extra condition. Di main rule dey work unless that proviso catch am.
example: You fit sublet, provided that landlord first give written consent.

pidgin_term: dem fit collect di whole money from any one of una
explanation: Each person is fully responsible for the whole obligation, not just their 'share'. Creditor fit chase one person for everything.
example: Three guarantors sign jointly and severally, so bank fit recover all di loan from only one of dem.

pidgin_term: person wey promise to pay if di main person no pay
explanation: You stand for another person's debt or duty. If they default, the creditor can come after you, sometimes even before chasing the main debtor, depending on the wording.
example: If your friend no pay di loan, as guarantor you fit dey the one wey bank go pursue.

pidgin_term: when you fail to do wetin you promise, especially payment
explanation: Failure to meet an obligation when due. Loan and lease papers list events of default that trigger extra powers (penalty, acceleration, eviction process).
example: Missing three EMI payments na default under di loan agreement.

pidgin_term: whole remaining debt become due at once
explanation: After default, lender fit declare that all remaining instalments are immediately payable, not just the missed ones.
example: Because of acceleration clause, once you default, bank fit demand the full ₦8 million at once.

pidgin_term: clause wey explain wetin go happen if big uncontrollable wahala land
explanation: The written rules for notice, delay, suspension, or exit when a force majeure event occurs. If e no dey the contract, common law frustration fit be harder to use.
example: Di force majeure clause require say you notify the other side within 7 days of the flood.

pidgin_term: to officially give court paper to di other person
explanation: Proper delivery of originating processes or notices. If service no correct, court fit set aside the case even if you 'win' in the person's absence.
example: Dropping writ for gateman without following the rules fit make service of process invalid.

pidgin_term: copy wey registry stamp say e match di original
explanation: Official copy of a filed document or public record, certified by the issuing office. Often required instead of photocopy.
example: Court go ask for certified true copy of the marriage certificate, not ordinary phone picture.

pidgin_term: dem no first tell di other side before court hear am
explanation: Some urgent applications proceed without first notifying the opponent. After, you usually still must serve them so they can come set it aside if need be.
example: They obtained a freezing order without notice because they feared dissipation of funds.

pidgin_term: money for lawyer and court expenses wey loser fit pay
explanation: Court fit order one party to pay the other party's legal costs. Winning your case no always mean you recover all lawyer fees.
example: Court give judgment plus costs of ₦200,000 against the defendant.

pidgin_term: to agree settle di matter instead of continue fight
explanation: Agreement that ends a dispute. If filed as consent judgment, e fit be enforced like a court order.
example: Una do settlement: landlord refund half deposit, tenant pack out in 21 days.

pidgin_term: oga fit answer for wetin worker do for work
explanation: Employer can be legally responsible for a worker's wrongful act if it happened in the course of employment.
example: Transport company get vicarious liability if their driver cause accident while carrying official passengers.

pidgin_term: work condition become so bad say person no get real choice but to resign
explanation: When an employer makes the job intolerable (demotion, unpaid salary for long, harassment) so the worker resigns. Law fit still treat am as dismissal.
example: If dem stop your salary for 5 months and lock your office, resignation fit be constructive dismissal.

pidgin_term: job end because di work no dey again, not because you do bad
explanation: Termination because the role is no longer needed. Labour Act and many contracts require notice and sometimes redundancy pay.
example: Company close that branch; staff go for redundancy, not sack for misconduct.

pidgin_term: dem comot you from work without follow di right process or fair reason
explanation: Termination that breaches contract, statute, or fair hearing. Remedy fit be damages; reinstatement dey more common in some public/labour settings.
example: Dem sack you on WhatsApp without query. That one fit be wrongful dismissal.

pidgin_term: rules wey govern how you use one service or app
explanation: Contract between you and the platform. Clicking 'I agree' fit bind you, but unfair or illegal clauses still fit be challenged.
example: Di terms of service say dem fit ban your account if you post hate speech.

pidgin_term: how dem go collect, use, and share your personal information
explanation: Notice plus legal duties on handling personal data. Nigeria has data protection rules (including NDPA/NDPR regime) that limit how companies use your data.
example: Privacy policy must tok if dem go sell your phone number to advertisers.
